posting.job_description:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.  
 The future won’t wait... why should you? Join us and make a difference. Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.  
 Are you in?
Your role Key responsibilities in your new role 
- Experience Research:  You conduct RF Immunity Test for Mems Sensors for mobile applications 
- Reliable work:  You support setup development, automation (MATLAB) and Component Verification 
- Data is everything:  You guarantee an analytical approach, through data analysis and reporting 
- Shape the future:  You investigate future solutions and prototyping 
Your profile Qualifications and skills to help you succeed  
- Study field:  You are currently studying Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, Physics or similar 
- Skills:  You have good programing skills in MATLAB and/or Python, as well as data processing and analysis skills with Excel and/or MATLAB 
- Knowledge:  You bring knowledge in radio frequency   
- Experience:  You already gained first laboratory experience (e.g. in soldering) and are familiar with using basic laboratory instruments such as RF Signal Generator, Vector signal Generator, multimeters and oscilloscopes   
- Interests:  As a plus you are also interested in the field of layout design with any tools, e.g. Altium designer   
- Language skills:  You have great English skills, both written and spoken
Please attach the following documents to your application: 
 - CV in English
- Certificate of enrollment at university
- Latest grades transcript (not older than 6 months)
- High school report
Important information: 
 - Working part-time : The focus is on studies. That’s why working as a student employee during lecture period is limited to a maximum of 20 hours per week. 
- Proper students (according to the German law) are welcome : To work as a student employee with us, you must be enrolled at a university and not have completed all of your exams or modules for your degree programme. You must not be in a semester of leave. We look forward to welcoming you to our team for at least 6 months.
- You should live close to the site : For good collaboration, it is important to us that you can come to the office regularly to integrate to the team.
Further links: 
 - Find out what we are looking for in your CV
- Find out how the student application process works with us
- Discover our student website
